moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: His reply to 'Elon please hire Jensen' about reinstating Nvidia’s ex‑CEO exploded, with over 4.7M views and massive engagement.

moments.author: Donald J. Trump (via Truth Social repost)
moments.quote: There is only one man to take his place – TIM COOK of Apple. A Legend replaces a Legend!
moments.why: A bold proposal for Nvidia’s new CEO from Trump’s circle, fueling intense debate around leadership in tech.

moments.author: Google DeepMind CEO (via Demis Hassabis)
moments.quote: One of the coolest things I’ve ever seen!! Loved the thunderclap... True alien tech. Huge congrats @elonmusk and the @SpaceX team!
moments.why: His ecstatic praise for SpaceX’s Starship capture post went viral across tech and space‑fan circles.

moments.author: Elon Musk
moments.why: A cheeky, viral product update about Robotaxi’s 24/7 operation that’s spreading fast among Tesla enthusiasts.

moments.author: SpaceX
moments.quote: Mechazilla catches Starship! Congratulations to the entire SpaceX team on this incredible achievement!
moments.why: Massively viral announcement of a milestone reusable Starship catch, captivating aero‑tech communities.
